verdict.rationale: Plan-based usage limits are a fair question for an agent-workflow orchestrator, but the evidence shows no pricing plans, daily task quotas, or plan-tied concurrency caps. The only related item is the parallel runner's "bounded concurrent fan-out" (yylo-docs-6). That is a user-configured execution bound, not a plan-based limit an engineering lead can view or manage, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can see and manage plan-based daily task and concurrency limits for agent workflows
